definitions.explanation: Describes a person or constitution that is physically weak and prone to illness. Often refers to an inherent or chronic condition of poor health.

examples.japanese: {虚弱|きょじゃく}{体質|たいしつ}
{子供|こども}の{頃|ころ}は{虚弱|きょじゃく}だった。
examples.english: I was frail as a child.

examples.japanese: {虚弱|きょじゃく}な{体|からだ}を{克服|こくふく}するために、{毎日|まいにち}{運動|うんどう}を{始|はじ}めた。
examples.english: I started exercising daily to overcome my weak constitution.

notes:
ADJECTIVE TYPE: Na-adjective. Uses な before nouns: {虚弱|きょじゃく}な{子供|こども}.

MEDICAL CONTEXT: {虚弱|きょじゃく}{体質|たいしつ} (weak constitution) is a common medical/health term describing someone prone to illness.

NUANCE: {虚弱|きょじゃく} typically describes an inherent weakness rather than temporary illness. It's often used for children or people with chronic health issues.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {虚弱|きょじゃく}{体質|たいしつ} (weak constitution)
- {虚弱|きょじゃく}な{体|からだ} (frail body)
- {虚弱|きょじゃく}な{子供|こども} (sickly child)

RELATED WORDS:
- {弱|よわ}い (weak - more common)
- {病弱|びょうじゃく} (sickly, delicate - similar)
- {頑健|がんけん} (sturdy, robust - opposite)
- {壮健|そうけん} (healthy, robust - opposite)
